title: Roasted Broccoli, Bell Pepper & Tofu Bowl with Peanut Sauce
style: Roasted vegetable and crispy tofu bowl with creamy peanut sauce
description: Caramelised roasted broccoli and bell pepper served over fluffy rice with crispy baked tofu and a rich, savoury peanut sauce.
steps: Preheat oven to 200°C with a rack in the upper third.
Cook the Rice: Boil rice in plenty of salted water for about 30 minutes until tender. Drain, return to pot, cover, and rest off heat for 5 minutes.
Roast the Vegetables: Toss broccoli and bell pepper with olive oil and a light sprinkle of salt. Spread evenly on a rimmed baking tray, flat sides down.
Roast for 25–30 minutes, turning once, until deeply golden and caramelised.
Prepare the Tofu: Drain tofu and gently squeeze out excess moisture. Cut into bite-sized cubes and press between towels under a weight for several minutes.
Toss tofu with olive oil and tamari, then coat evenly with arrowroot starch. Spread on a lined baking tray.
Bake at 200°C for 25–30 minutes, turning halfway, until crisp and golden.
Make the Peanut Sauce: Whisk together peanut butter, tamari, vinegar, maple syrup, sesame oil, garlic, and chilli flakes. Thin with water until thick but pourable.
Assemble: Fluff rice and season to taste. Divide into bowls, top with roasted vegetables and tofu, drizzle with peanut sauce, and finish with garnishes.
tips: Arrange vegetables cut-side down for maximum caramelisation.
The peanut sauce keeps refrigerated for up to 4 days and works well as a dip.
For nut allergies, use sunflower seed butter and omit the peanut garnish.
